newsitem.title: UK: EMU needs sustained convergence - EU Commissioner.
newsitem.headline: EMU needs sustained convergence - EU Commissioner.

text.p: European Union monetary affairs Commissioner Yves-Thibault de Silguy said on Thursday that to qualify for European Economic and Monetary Union (EMU) countries must show sustained economic convergence.
"We want to avoid any one-off measures to qualify for the euro," de Silguy told journalists following a series of meetings with British financial authorities and industry leaders in London.

"If it's not sustainable, it will not be sufficient (to join EMU)," he said. This was in response to a query about a hypothetical situation where some European countries made last-minute efforts to make the EMU grade which were not deemed sustainable.
